tools.name: search_catalog
tools.description: UCP Catalog search across independent WooCommerce merchants in KaliCart Global. catalog.query is free text; catalog.filters.categories accepts KaliCart canonical category values as returned in products[].categories (taxonomy "kalicart", e.g. "home.bedroom.pillows"); filters.price is in ISO 4217 mino

tools.name: lookup_catalog
tools.description: UCP Catalog lookup by product or variant identifier (gid://kalicart/Product/... or gid://kalicart/ProductVariant/...). Up to 25 ids. Reads price and availability live from each merchant when possible (metadata.kalicart.source = "live"), otherwise returns the indexed snapshot and says so. Unknown ids

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: UCP Catalog product detail by product or variant id. Reads variants, price and availability live from the merchant KaliCart Bridge within a short time budget; if the merchant does not answer in time the indexed snapshot is returned and marked as such. The product url is the merchant storefront where
